faultPolicy: Faulted is terminal for this registry. The triggering call publishes an empty snapshot and revokes/invalidates all old active SourceIds exactly once.

If IdentityEpoch exhaustion triggers Faulted and old CatalogRevision is below Int64.MaxValue, clearing a nonempty snapshot increments CatalogRevision once. If old sources are already empty, no revision increment is needed.
If CatalogRevision is already Int64.MaxValue when a changed snapshot would be committed, Faulted publishes empty sources at the SAME Int64.MaxValue; never wraps or fabricates a higher revision.

Further ApplySnapshot calls always return Faulted with the same empty snapshot and unchanged CatalogRevision; all three delta lists are empty. They cannot reactivate devices, consume generations or repeat revocations.
scope: Synthetic boundary tests may set private counters by reflection; no production test hook or runtime adapter wiring is authorized.
